# strettchcloud_specification (Data Source)

Finds a single compute specification by filter. At least one filter is required; filters combine with AND. Zero matches or more than one match is an error when read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up one specification by slug...
data "strettchcloud_specification" "by_slug" {
  specification = "S-1C-1G"
}

# ...or by size. Filters combine with AND and must match exactly one entry.
data "strettchcloud_specification" "by_size" {
  vcpus     = 2
  memory_mb = 4096
}

# List every specification in the catalog.
data "strettchcloud_specifications" "all" {}

output "all_slugs" {
  value = data.strettchcloud_specifications.all.specifications[*].specification
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB. Filter and output.
- `specification` (String) Specification slug, e.g. `S-1C-1G`. Filter and output.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs. Filter and output.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Specification identifier. Output only.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage in GB. Output only.
